paragraphs: Advanced Utility Systems makes customer information and billing software for utilities. It sells to electric, water, gas and multi-service providers across North America and the Caribbean.

The main product, CIS Infinity, brings meter-to-cash data together in one place. Utilities can choose cloud hosting or an on-premise installation. Integrated SMS messaging sends payment reminders, service notifications and outage updates to customers. A customer engagement option builds videos from account data and delivers them by email or text.

The company reports use across 134 utility companies and 6.6 million customer service points. It states the platform is audited to SOC 2 Type I and supports alignment with NIST 800-53, StateRAMP, CCPA and GDPR. The site lists an address in Markham, Ontario.
